values.note: $10 a night per single site, the same in every rate season 2026-2028 on recreation.gov (peak, non-peak and the October-November first-come season).

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/huron-manistee/recreation/au-sable-loop-campground-and-day-use-area ('Overnight Use: Single Site: $10 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10214374/rates (Peak/Off-Peak/Walk-In Au Sable Loop camping fee 10 in every 2026-2028 season), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Interagency Senior and Access passes take 50% off a single campsite occupied by the pass holder, not other sites of the party.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/huron-manistee/recreation/au-sable-loop-campground-and-day-use-area ('Interagency Senior and Access Recreation Passes provide a 50% discount to single campsites only'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: RIDB campsite catalog for facility 10214374 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20: all 5 sites 'STANDARD NONELECTRIC', 'Water Hookup: No'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Five sites: two pull-throughs and three back-ins, all open to RVs. The catalog's vehicle lengths (38, 45, 75, 90, 99 ft) are not believable for a five-site rustic campground and are not used.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10214374 ('The small five site campground') + RIDB campsite catalog (sites 2 and 5 'Driveway Entry: Pull-through', sites 1, 3, 4 back-in; RV and trailer equipment on all), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Hand-pump well, vault toilet, trash collection; picnic table, fire ring and lantern post at each site. In winter no toilet facilities.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10214374 ('provides a handpump well for drinking water, a vault toilet, and trash collection services'; notice 'No toilet facilities are available' in winter) + FS page ('Vault toilet(s)', 'drinking water is available from a hand pump'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Not maintained December 1 - April 30: not gated, but the access road and lot are not plowed and there are no toilets. Reservations cover May 15 - September 30; October 1 - November 30 is a first-come season.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/huron-manistee/recreation/au-sable-loop-campground-and-day-use-area ('Seasons of Use: Year-round; Not maintained December 1 - April 30') + recreation.gov notice ('This site is not gated during the off season. It not maintained in winter. Access road and/or parking lot are not plowed. No toilet facilities are available') + rate seasons (Peak/Non-Peak May 15 - Sep 30; 'First-come, First-served Season' Oct 1 - Nov 30), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Run directly by the Forest Service (Mio Ranger District), not a concessionaire; unstaffed. Three of the five sites are reservable on recreation.gov, two are first-come; the whole campground is first-come October 1 - November 30. Occupy a reserved site within 24 hours of its start or it may be forfeited. Up to 14 consecutive nights.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10214374 (org FS, is_commercially_managed false; 'This location is unstaffed'; notices 'Some sites are available on a first-come, first serve basis', 'You must occupy your site within 24 hours'; maxConsecutiveStay 14; minConsecutiveStay 1) + RIDB catalog (sites 1, 3, 5 reservable, 2 and 4 not) + FS page ('Recreation Region: Mio Ranger District', 'Recreation.gov Reservations'), read 2026-10-25

note: Tiny Huron NF campground in mixed hardwoods beside the Au Sable Loop Scenic Overlook off McKinley Road east of Mio, reached on an unpaved road from the overlook, on the National Scenic stretch of the Au Sable River; a short path leads down to the river for wading and fishing. --Claude
summary: recreation.gov + RIDB catalog + Forest Service page: FS-run (Mio Ranger District, phone 989-826-3252 matches), 5 sites (2 pull-through), 3 reservable and 2 first-come, all first-come Oct 1 - Nov 30, $10/night (confirmed), 14-night max, no hookups, vault toilet and hand-pump water; added year-round season (not maintained Dec 1 - Apr 30) and the stated Senior/Access 50% discount. Current forest alerts (March 2026 winter storm, April 2026 flooding, Iargo Springs closure) don't list this site; the active 'Au Sable National Scenic River Camping Restrictions' order is the river-corridor rule.
